name: Personal agent current work and next actions
summary: Personal attention retains bounded work snapshots with separate truncation flags. Only blockers/dependencies block undelivered work; delivered review takes precedence. Every own queue row and next action carries whose_move (you, reviewer, coordinator or unknown, relative to the caller) and next, one sentence from the validated review state alone: changes requested is the caller's work until it delivers a revision that supersedes the contribution and answers each item, and once that revision is delivered and unanswered the row owes only the responses; review and integration belong to the reviewer or the coordinator; a caller whose own checkpoint records a blocker or dependency is quoted in that checkpoint's own words, escaped, with no person inferred, and the move and the count stay the caller's. Own-move items sort first and top-level your_move counts every reconciled queue row, not the page. The agent next-actions answer carries the two fields only where the kind is changes-requested, from the same canonical row. Flagged in-progress tasks sort first before the action cap; errors and unknown counts never imply idle.
